item.create_hand_made.infusion_gun.toolt: A tool for hand-_injecting_, _extracting_ and _placing_ fluids.
Short right-click on a Depot or Belt
_Inject_ fluid from the gun into items
Short right-click on a fluid container
_Store_ the gun's fluid into the container
Hold right-click on a fluid container
_Extract_ fluid from the container (sneak: slow; otherwise: fill up)
Hold right-click on a fluid source block
_Pick up_ the entire fluid source block
